author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
When Christopher Nolan was shooting The Odyssey, every reel of 65mm film shot during production went from the IMAX camera to a film processing lab in Burbank, California to be developed and seen for the very first time. Adam Savage visits the film labs at FotoKem, the place where 65mm/70mm film begins its post-production journey from delicate negative to the  precious prints projected in theaters around the world. 

Shot and edited by Joey Fameli
Music by Jinglepunks
